Jokic (DEN) is in the path of Brogdon (MIL) and does not deliver contact.
Murray (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position on Bledsoe's (MIL) shot.
Bledsoe (MIL) makes incidental contact with Murray's (DEN) head during his driving shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.

Jokic (DEN) is in the path of Bledsoe (MIL) and does not deliver contact.
Lopez (MIL) and Harris (DEN) briefly engage and disengage with one another after the pick.
Murray (DEN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Jokic (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position on Middleton's (MIL) jump shot.
Murray (DEN) is in the path of Antetokounmpo (MIL) and does not deliver contact during the screen.

Bledsoe (MIL) and Murray (DEN) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) maintains a legal guarding position on Millsap's (DEN) shot.
Harris (DEN) engages with Middleton (MIL) and affects his FOM.

Beasley (DEN) places one hand on Middleton's (MIL) body but slides it off as Middleton (MIL) moves away.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) maintains a legal guarding position on Beasley's (DEN) shot.
